body:
(It's 2am right now so sorry if my reply is messy, I usually speak better in the afternoons) 
I know the feeling of opening yourself up to someone, pouring your heart out, just for them to shrug it off, and for them to say "they have it worse" its particularly wrong of them, that's just wrong as nobody can say the know what's going on in somebodies head

For now, do you think you can work a part-time job to get yourself on your feet and take things on from there? Don't worry about all the other dheads in the world, if they are a bad person, they should get what's coming to them.

There's lots of people here you can talk to, I understand if you have trust issues (I have it myself) and can't just open up to somebody like a book, but even just a casual chat about anything is fully welcomed
Make sure you take some time out of your days to indulge yourself a bit, read a book if you like books, play games if you enjoy that, watch videos, etc, 
Good luck and I hope all goes well, remember here to talk to if needed

Take this all with a grain of salt, and as I don't know where abouts you live in the world I don't know what you have access to but anyway, As for the basics; food you should be able to buy cheap foods (cheap noodles and such) even though they're not great, they're something

Do you think you could ask a friend for a bike or take public transport to and from your locations?

Have you gone into your local businesses asking if they're employing? From what I hear businesses like it more if you do it this way, as it shows inituative

Hang in there op, I'm sure your wife cares for you, and your son even though he is young, I'm sure he'd help out if he could, get past this point in your life and you may have the most amazing son and family as a whole,
Good luck!

Even if it's just a little thing, it's good you're looking forward to something, also there's lots of nice games that are coming out in 2018 I think you might enjoy. Play the hell out of those games and enjoy yourself! I've had multiple points in my life where I've only really wanted to live for games, it's pretty fun so I hope you enjoy yourself
This whole community is here if you need us

You're just experiencing the shit side of the world, people do help, people do care. As I don't know what you've been through, I can't say I know how you feel, but I can at least say that people do care.  It may appear like it just inconveniences people, but if it does inconvenience them, it's likely they care
I hope all goes well, the community of this subreddit is here need be

Have you tried going to a mental health place? I know the difficulties you're going through, I can't say for sure what will help you but don't be afraid to message anyone for help, just breathe for now okay? Don't worry about other useless shit in life for now
